name: PvP progression: Honor, ranks & seasons
summary: PvP has two tracks. Honor is a currency from player kills, battlegrounds and PvP quests that you spend on gear; Rank Points come from battlegrounds and PvP quests and climb the 14 classic ranks each season (with a weekly cap). Your rank decides what you're allowed to buy.
route: Rank 8: epic bracers or belt upgrade token
Rank 12: epic legs or shoulders token
Rank 13: epic chest or helm token
Rank 14 (Grand Marshal / High Warlord): epic weapons
steps: Honor buys a blue PvP set and an epic set; each epic piece needs the blue piece plus an Emboldened Seal (rank-gated)
Higher ranks unlock cosmetic Elite versions of the PvP armour
Each season has a Field of Honor journey of weekly tasks giving Honor and Rank Points; weeks 4, 7 and 10 also give a Legacy Point
Honor rates were evened out across battlegrounds, so Alterac Valley isn't the only efficient choice
Holiday-week battlegrounds give bonus Honor and Rank Points
Shamans now have healer, melee and caster PvP sets
tips: Check your rank and what you can buy in the PvP tab of the character pane (C)
Plan Emboldened Seal rank requirements before buying epic pieces
Rank 14 needs 24,750 Rank Points in total (per early guides)
